name: position rounding
description: Being rounded with SSB Fix support 🤯

ssb-fix-enabled.name: SSB Fix (X-Pos Desync Compensation)
ssb-fix-enabled.description: Enables time correction to fix music desync caused by X rounding. Doesn't work for Y-Velocity rounding.

enable-debug-logs.name: Enable Debug Logs
enable-debug-logs.description: Prints calculation details into the Geode console Used while developing the mod for debugging. May lag the game because it sends logs every frame idk if that does some lag.

show-timer.name: Show Timer
show-timer.description: Displays an independent wall-clock timer on the screen. Used while developing the mod for debugging. You don't need this unless you're trying to help me code this.

tps-value.name: Macro TPS
tps-value.description: The TPS used in your macro for precise calculations.

y-rounding-target.name: Y Velocity Rounding
y-rounding-target.description: round Y velocity to nearest value.

x-rounding-target.name: X Position Rounding
x-rounding-target.description: snap X position to a grid step size.
